introduction_markdown:
**CAMEROON GENERAL CERTIFICATE OF EDUCATION BOARD - ORDINARY LEVEL EXAMINATION - CHEMISTRY (0515), Paper 2, June 2019. Time allowed: two and a half hours.**

This paper is arranged in three sections, A, B and C.

- Section A: answer 4 questions out of 5;
- Section B: answer 2 questions out of 3 and
- Section C: answer both questions.

In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Calculators are allowed.

You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers.

enonce_intro_markdown: This question concerns the laboratory preparation of ammonia ($\mathrm{NH_3}$) by reacting a mixture of ammonium chloride and calcium hydroxide.
incertitudes: Le sujet se contredit : l'en-tête de la page de garde demande 4 questions sur 5 en Section A, mais le titre de la Section A dit « Answer ALL questions in this section ». La règle de l'en-tête est retenue.
Points imprimés 2 + 1 + 1 + 3 + 2 = 9, pour « Total = 10 marks » : recopiés tels quels.

En (d)(i) le sujet demande « the reduction of NH3 » : or NH3 est oxydé. Le texte est recopié tel qu'imprimé (avec une précision entre crochets) et le corrigé donne l'équation de la réaction où NH3 réduit CuO.

questions.enonce_markdown:
(i) Why is it advisable to grind the mixture of ammonium chloride and calcium hydroxide?

(ii) State the reaction condition. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) Grinding the two solids together **increases the surface area** in contact, so that they mix intimately and react faster and more completely.

(ii) The mixture must be **heated** (gently, in a hard-glass test tube or flask whose mouth is tilted slightly downwards so that the water formed does not run back onto the hot glass).

questions.enonce_markdown: Write an equation for the reaction. *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
$2\mathrm{NH_4Cl} + \mathrm{Ca(OH)_2} \xrightarrow{\text{heat}} \mathrm{CaCl_2} + 2\mathrm{H_2O} + 2\mathrm{NH_3}$

(Check: left 2 N, 8 + 2 = 10 H, 2 Cl, 1 Ca, 2 O; right 1 Ca, 2 Cl, 4 + 6 = 10 H, 2 O, 2 N. Balanced.)

questions.enonce_markdown: State the drying agent used. *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown: **Quicklime (calcium oxide, CaO)**, usually in a drying tower or tube. Concentrated sulphuric acid and anhydrous calcium chloride cannot be used because they react with ammonia.

questions.enonce_markdown:
Ammonia gas is used as a reducing agent for copper(II) oxide.

(i) Write an equation to show the reduction of $\mathrm{NH_3}$ [as printed; the equation required is the reaction in which ammonia reduces copper(II) oxide].

(ii) State one observation when the copper(II) oxide is reduced. *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) Ammonia is oxidised to nitrogen while copper(II) oxide is reduced to copper:

$3\mathrm{CuO} + 2\mathrm{NH_3} \rightarrow 3\mathrm{Cu} + \mathrm{N_2} + 3\mathrm{H_2O}$

(Check: left 3 Cu, 3 O, 2 N, 6 H; right 3 Cu, 2 N, 6 H, 3 O. Balanced.)

(ii) The **black copper(II) oxide turns reddish-brown** (copper metal is formed). Drops of colourless liquid (water) also condense on the cooler part of the tube.

questions.enonce_markdown:
Give one large scale use of

(i) Nitrogen.

(ii) Ammonia. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) **Nitrogen:** manufacture of ammonia (Haber process); also as an inert atmosphere for food packaging, or as liquid nitrogen for freezing and cooling.

(ii) **Ammonia:** manufacture of **fertilisers** (such as ammonium sulphate and ammonium nitrate); also manufacture of nitric acid.
